justice: Two-lane rural main road connecting suburban countryside areas.
Serves mixed traffic of small vehicles, agricultural vehicles and sightseeing traffic.
safety: Long straight alignment, excellent open sight distance.
Low traffic volume, no complex intersection interference.
livability: Surrounded by flower and tree landscape belts, adjacent to farmland.
Quiet rural environment, insufficient supporting facilities.
sustainability: Large area of native flowering shrubs and forest vegetation on both sides.
Good ecological maintenance and carbon sequestration capacity.
aesthetics: Symmetrical blooming green belts on both sides, open rural natural scenery.
comfort: Smooth flat pavement, fresh air and wide view.
walkability: Simple roadside walking space, low pedestrian flow.
bikeability: Spacious riding lane, low vehicle interference.
